financial_finding: H1 revenue grew to $363.881M, but operating income fell to $37.033M from $64.010M and OCF-PPE was -$1.907M before SBC and finance-lease economics.
economic_risk: OCS/NOP creates differentiated clinical and logistics value, but rising service mix, aircraft/logistics fixed costs, headquarters capital intensity and unresolved inventory controls can delay conversion of growth into per-share owner cash.
rights_and_capital: Use Q2 diluted 40.709227M shares as the valuation proxy so convertible-note dilution is not double-counted. Keep finance-lease liability, HQ capital needs and PAD Aviation cash needs as separate economic claims. PAD transaction economics remain insufficiently disclosed for precise underwriting.
falsifier: If OCS adoption continues while service/logistics unit economics fail to improve, cash conversion remains negative after maintenance/reinvestment, or the inventory-control material weakness persists beyond a reasonable remediation period, moat/management and valuation assumptions require a full rewrite.
portfolio_instruction: Research completion is not a purchase authorization. Do not infer position size without actual holdings, tax context and risk budget.
